args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health check failures
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully. v2.3.1 should be investigated and re-validated in staging before any redeploy attempt.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Reviewing deployment history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions — the rollback completed successfully ("rolled_out" in us-east, us-west, and eu-west).
3. **Opened incident**: Filed **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the health check failures, the rollback action, and a recommendation that v2.3.1 be investigated and re-validated in staging before any redeploy attempt. The on-call engineer has been paged.

transcript.content: I'll first look at the deployment history and current status for checkout-api to identify the most recent healthy release.
